objective: Improve geometric-mean WHATWG URL parse, href serialize/update, and URLSearchParams parse/serialize throughput using the pinned upstream benchmark/url harness. All parallel/test-url* and parallel/test-whatwg-url* tests, byte-exact serialized outputs, and peak heap/RSS no greater than the measured baseline plus 2% are hard gates. Only src/node_url.cc, src/node_url.h, lib/internal/url.js, deps/ada/ada.cpp, deps/ada/ada.h, and deps/ada/ada_c.h are mutable.

meta.provenance: nodejs/node at exact revision 9df0e9b4d4a5be5ce7506fae44acb6667bb68d6b; current-head terminal capsule with no reference patch; terminal holdout assets and all diagnostic measurements remain capsule-local and were never exposed to an optimizer; interleaved fresh-process A-A samples [3033080.8615360023, 3048513.748301425, 3039970.3553504916] give qBase=3040521.6550626396 and sample sigma=7731.199584026476; qReference=qBase+max(5*sigma,0.05*abs(qBase-qFail))=3192547.7378157717; independently authored URLSearchParams serialization caching passes all gates and moves q

measurement.q: geometric mean ops/sec across 16 frozen upstream benchmark/url cells per split

exploitReview.protectedPathEscape: the broker protects evaluator, build, benchmark, test, fixture, and toolchain paths; the evaluator byte-hashes every non-mutable candidate file against the trusted baseline and rejects additions, deletions, symlinks, and repository metadata
exploitReview.benchmarkSpecialCasing: train and validation choose disjoint holdout benchmark/common URL and SearchParams identities; the shortcut diagnostic accelerates recognized train inputs but is slowed and rejected in ordering on unseen validation inputs
exploitReview.fixtureFingerprinting: both terminal splits are holdout-visible only to the trusted terminal diagnostic path; workload JSON is staged root-only and only validated benchmark arguments are passed to unprivileged processes
exploitReview.outputFabrication: a protected exact-output worker independently constructs real URL and URLSearchParams objects and byte-compares href and form serialization against sealed expected outputs before scoring
exploitReview.timerTampering: the protected NODE_OPTIONS memory probe makes process.hrtime non-writable and non-configurable before the protected upstream benchmark harness loads candidate URL code
exploitReview.buildScriptMutation: configuration, Ninja graph, evaluator, worker, benchmark sources, tests, and toolchain lock are protected; only six implementation files are copied into a fresh image-backed build volume
exploitReview.deadCodeBenchmarkBypass: the protected upstream scripts retain live result values and benchmark the same URL and URLSearchParams entry points covered by the exact-output gate and upstream parallel tests
